The unchanged files `tais_jalc.c`, `tais_jalc.h`, and `LICENSE` come from [TAIS commit c751bd6](https://github.com/Sver0411/TAIS/tree/c751bd6d71719d1fbb178800dd62eca0cf11325e/src/tais/closed_loop/c11). The project-owned bridge in `sensor_node/jalc_bridge` connects its synchronous C11 controller to asynchronous gateway receipts. The kernel does not import the research simulator or its datasets.
